test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: The difference between the compound interest (compounding annually) and simple interest on a sum at the rate of 30 percent per annum for 2 years is Rs. 5400. What is the sum?
solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest (R) = 30% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

Difference between compound interest and simple interest = Rs. 5400

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) for 2 years = P(1 + R/100)² - P

Simple Interest (SI) for 2 years = P × R × T / 100

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years = P(1 + R/100)² - P - PRT / 100

**Calculation:**

Given the difference between CI and SI for 2 years is Rs. 5400

⇒ P[(1 + 30/100)² - 1] - P × 30 × 2 / 100 = 5400

⇒ P[(1.3)² - 1] - P × 0.6 = 5400

⇒ P[1.69 - 1 - 0.6] = 5400

⇒ P[0.09] = 5400

⇒ P = 5400 / 0.09

⇒ P = 60000

**The sum is Rs. 60000.**
